title: Position: The Pitfalls of Over-Alignment: Overly Caution Health-Related Responses From LLMs are Unethical and Dangerous
reasoning: The paper explicitly characterizes the current alignment of LLMs as 'unethical' and uses formal ethical frameworks such as utilitarianism, Kantian principles (deontology), and virtue ethics to argue its position. It evaluates models based on their alignment with these ethical values versus harmful over-alignment.
